thread:
alice_support: Hey team — customer-42 opened a ticket: sudden 403s right after we rotated their API key in eu-west1 (~2h ago). They say calls to the hosted endpoint started failing with `403 invalid_api_key`. Reported around 15:23 UTC. @carla_sre any idea if rotation -> edge propagation lag is possible here?

carla_sre: Can you drop the request-id and the response body (redact secrets)? Also which deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private)?

alice_support: Request id: req_0a7b9c, sample response: `{"error":"invalid_api_key","code":403}`. They're on hosted API but routed through our EU edge (eu-west1). They rotated via our support flow (we called the rotation API).

jenna_customer: customer message pasted here: "We rotated the key as advised and updated our env, but requests from our EU users still get 403. We tried curl from our EU app and from our dev laptop (US) — US worked, EU 403."

bob_infra: Quick check of the rotation job logs: it wrote the new secret to Vault at path `secret/data/customers/customer42` and set TTL=3600 then revoked the previous key. However, the edge cache invalidation job returned 500 for eu cluster. Logs: ```[2024-06-22T13:12:01Z] edge-invalidator: POST /api/purge eu-west1 -> 500 InternalError, body: "Timeout while waiting for edge-control"```

bob_infra: That would explain region-specific 403s if some edge nodes still accept old key whitelist or conversely still routing to pods with old env. Also seeing some pods in the eu replica set didn't restart as expected after secret update.

dave_engineer: Confirmed: the k8s rollout policy for that deployment has `rollout.kubernetes.io/strategy=manual` from an earlier experiment, so the sidecars didn't pick up the new env. Commands I ran: ```kubectl get deploy api-eu -o yaml | grep -i strategy -A2``` and ```kubectl get pods -l region=eu,app=api -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'``` — several pods still show env var API_KEY with old fingerprint.

carla_sre: So root cause looks like a combination: vault rotated key -> controller updated secret, but two failures: 1) edge cache purge failed in eu, 2) deployment didn't auto-restart due to manual rollout annotation. Result: some client traffic hitting pods with stale env or edge nodes that haven't invalidated the old key -> 403s.

alice_support: Proposed mitigation steps for support team to offer customer: 1) perform a rolling restart of EU pods (kubectl rollout restart deploy/api-eu) OR patch env directly for emergency. 2) retry edge purge via infra console (we can escalate). 3) if they need immediate unblock, create a short-lived fallback API key via support portal and whitelist it while we fix propagation.

carla_sre: I'll trigger a manual edge purge and follow up in 5m. If purge fails, ops will do a circuit restart on the invalidator cluster.

deploy-bot: edge-invalidator-job/291 triggered purge for eu-west1 by carla_sre at 2024-06-22T13:18:12Z -> response 202 Accepted (job queued).

bob_infra: Also adding a quick diagnostic command for on-call: ```vault kv get -field=key secret/data/customers/customer42 || echo 'not found'``` and for pod env check: ```kubectl exec -it <pod> -- printenv | grep API_KEY``` — helps confirm which pods still have old key.

dave_engineer: I'll patch the deployment annotation to allow automated restarts next rotation and add a lint to the rotation pipeline to fail if rollout strategy is manual for customer-facing deployments. Filing follow-up PR.

jenna_customer: Customer restarted their EU deployment (they ran `kubectl rollout restart deploy/api-eu`) and reports 200s now for a handful of requests. They asked for confirmation the rollout is safe across all pods.

alice_support: Glanced: after the restart, 100% of sampled requests in eu returned 200 in our logs for the past 3 minutes. I'll update the ticket with mitigation steps + ETA for permanent fix.

carla_sre: Next steps for us: (A) ensure edge purge reliability (investigate 500s/timeouts), (B) enforce auto-restart or pipeline checks, (C) add a short verification step post-rotation that probes each region and validates key acceptance. I'll add an item to infra backlog. :thumbsup:

alice_support: Escalating to P2 for now and adding to incident tracker INC-2024-142. Notifying customer that workaround applied; we'll follow up with RCA once infra confirms purge reliability.

jenna_customer: Customer acknowledges, asked for the RCA and timeline. I'll keep them updated.
